description: Get a job's settlement status from its own escrow records: status (settled only when a settlement read confirms the release; reported_released when the milestone record says released but nothing confirms it; simulated for a mock escrow; awaiting_settlement, no_settlement_record, unknown or unavailable otherwise), settled, payout, paidAmount (confirmed releases only), reportedReleasedAmount, quotedAmount, currency (recorded or null), escrow, milestones, the negotiation session, notices and asOf.
name: pcc_job_settlement
